d: Video description: In Shahdara, the sweltering heat often surpasses 50 degrees, affecting daily wage earners and small vendors. We explored the temperature disparities across Delhi, revealing a stark contrast between rich, shaded areas and poorer, heat-absorbing neighborhoods. With thermal cameras, we documented temperatures inside crowded homes, which often felt hotter than outside. Many families struggled with sleepless nights and inadequate ventilation, resorting to makeshift cooling methods.
